newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: MONTELL Q2 MARGINS PRESSURED BY FEEDSTOCK PRICES.
newsitem.headline: MONTELL Q2 MARGINS PRESSURED BY FEEDSTOCK PRICES.

text.p: Plastics producer Montell Polyolefins said on Thursday sharply higher olefin feedstock prices pressured second-quarter operating margins.

Montell -- a polypropylene and polyethylene joint venture between Royal Dutch/Shell and Italy's Montedison -- earlier reported second quarter operating profits of 76 million guilders (excluding associates), down from 99 million in the year-earlier period.
"Sharply higher olefin feedstock prices...could only be partially recovered by increased polymer prices," Montell said.
However, industry demand for polypropylene in the second quarter had remained strong, it said.
"During the first six months, industry demand has increased more than 11 percent in western Europe and eight percent in North America," it said.
Revenues in the second quarter rose 7.5 percent in dollar terms due to increased volumes and higher selling prices.
Montell claims market leadership in the production, marketing and sales of polyolefins, advanced materials and related products.
